stable.label: ecosystem-sandbox-fluid-refinement-ci-pass
stable.note: The restored multi-creature ecosystem remains the primary GENESIS experience. The new finer water layer has local and independent GitHub Actions test evidence, but the deployed ecosystem route is not yet live/device verified. Physical Creature V1 remains preserved as a separate CI-proven causal test slice.

active_experience.current_change: make the existing world/fluid simulation finer and less visually/mechanically janky without replacing the ecosystem sandbox
simulation_changes: morphology-aware jaw and tongue node re-anchoring toward front/underside mouth geometry
per-creature local wetness/biome cache derived from existing material/saturation state
2x-per-axis subcell water-volume state layered over the existing V110 coarse water reservoir
pairwise conservative gravity and lateral volume transfers inside the active refined region
damped momentum proxy for refined water flow
gradual bidirectional coarse/fine water synchronization instead of whole-cell teleporting
hysteretic synchronization of visible AIR/WATER material classification from refined volume
creature-node drag, buoyancy-like lift/current coupling, and local water displacement that redistributes refined water mass
terrain-change evacuation attempts for refined water when coarse material becomes solid
presentation_changes: wet creature highlights derived from simulated saturation
cleaner front/underslung mouth presentation and stronger eye direction
surface highlight/foam derived from refined fluid velocity rather than random animation
approximations: canopy, light shafts, foreground foliage and extra plant leaves are presentation layers, not new physical simulation
biome labels are classifications derived from local material/heat/wetness fields, not separate simulated biome agents
jaw re-anchoring changes existing jaw/tongue nodes but does not replace the older bite/feeding model with the isolated Physical Creature V1 ingestion model
V109/V110 remain coarse grid/transfer approximations and are not CFD
fluid_refinement is a conservative 2x subcell volume-relaxation / finite-volume-like cellular approximation; it is not Navier-Stokes CFD, SPH, FLIP, PBF, or MPM
refined water velocity is a damped momentum proxy derived from transferred volume, not a solved incompressible velocity field
creature water lift is an authored buoyancy-like coupling, not full fluid-body pressure integration

fluid_refinement.representation: 2D subcell water-volume field with pairwise conservative transfer and damped momentum proxy

physical_creature_v1.representation: 2D point-mass articulated skeleton with projected distance constraints and lumped joint-torque muscle actuators
physical_creature_v1.note: This lab is retained for causal body/feeding test work but is not the primary user-facing GENESIS route.

legacy_snapshot.note: Snapshot of the pre-restoration V100-V110 stack without old_sim_upgrade.js or fluid_refinement.js.

active_objective: Exercise the deployed /genesis-codehood/ route in a functioning browser and inspect refined-fluid stability, frame cost, creature-water coupling and visual smoothness before increasing verification or adding another major subsystem.
next_gate: LIVE_TESTED still requires actual deployed browser execution of the ecosystem with fluid_refinement.js active. CI_PASS proves the deterministic Node contract and syntax only; a source fetch or CI result alone is insufficient for live runtime/device claims.
invariants: ROADMAP != IMPLEMENTED != TESTED != CI_PASS != LIVE_TESTED != DEVICE_TESTED != VERIFIED
The ecosystem sandbox is the primary user-facing experience
Physical Creature V1 CI evidence remains preserved and must not be re-described as proof of the ecosystem stack
Presentation layers must not be described as physics
No interpolation may be called physics
No authored controller may be called learning

The refined water solver must conserve pairwise internal transfer mass within tolerance when coarse synchronization is disabled
Refined fluid visualization must read refined WATER state rather than author fluid outcomes
fluid_refinement must not be called CFD/SPH/FLIP/PBF/MPM
CI_PASS does not imply live deployment PASS
Unknown or unexercised runtime state remains UNKNOWN/NOT_TESTED
